title: Google Analytics Consent Mode & Rybbit Analytics Fix
body:
- Enabled Google Analytics (gtag.js) with Google Consent Mode v2 defaults so measurement works across all regions while respecting GDPR consent.
- Enabled cookieless Rybbit analytics for all visitors without gating it on non-GDPR CMP responses.
- Updated Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy disclosures to match the analytics setup.
